name: Robust
description: Gain +1 HP per level.

name: Deft
description: Gain a 1d4 bonus to spell saving throws.

name: Eager
description: Gain +1 willpower after slaying an enemy.

name: Stalwart
description: Gain +2 HP per level, but no bonus to willpower from character level.

name: Second Wind
description: Once a day, you can use an action and 2 willpower to recover 2d6 hp.

name: Untouchable
description: Gain +2 DC whenever you take the {{actions.dodge}} action, as long as you are not wearing heavy armor.

name: Moving Target
description: Gain +1 DC whenever you take the {{actions.move}} action, and +2 DC whenever you take the {{actions.jog}} action.

name: Specialist
description: Choose an attribute. All skill trainings associated with that attribute cost one less training slot. This feat cannot be taken multiple times, and is mutually exclusive with "Jack of all Trades" and "Prodigy".

name: Prodigy
description: Training skill proficiency levels to expertise or mastery costs 1 fewer training slots.

name: Jack of All Trades
description: Remediation and proficiency skill training require one fewer training slot, but other training is increased by 1.

name: Merciless
description: Whenever you overkill an enemy by 5 or more, gain one willpower.

name: Reckless
description: Whenever you dodge a hit that would have knocked you unconscious, gain 1d4 willpower.

name: Relentless
description: Up to 12 feet of unused movement points carry over to the next turn.

name: Double Checker
description: You can expend 1 willpower to reroll {{skills.perception}} checks, once per check.

name: Night Owl
description: You have advantage on skill checks between midnight and sunrise.

name: Early Riser
description: You have advantage on your first skill check each morning.

name: Urbane
description: You have advantage on {{skills.persuasion}} and {{skills.performance}} checks with members of polite society.

name: Polished
description: When rolling any die (including damage dice), you can preemptively expend 1 willpower to reroll any 1s.

name: Chic
description: This feat does nothing, but everyone agrees it makes you look extremely fashionable.

name: Resurgence
description: Second wind healing is increased to 2d12.

name: Take Backsies
description: Once a day, you can expend willpower to reroll a skill check or saving throw that you failed. The amount of willpower required is equal to the amount by which you failed the roll.

name: Relentless 2
description: Up to 24 feet of unused movement points carry over to your next turn.

name: Stone Pate
description: Enemies can't crit against you unless they had advantage on the attack roll. Their critical hits become normal hits.

name: Artful Dodger
description: Gain 1 willpower whenever you take the {{actions.dodge}} action.

name: Evasion Action
description: You can use your {{attr.SPD}} attribute as the base for your DC, instead of {{attr.DEX}} whenever you take the {{actions.jog}} action.

name: Arcane Apprentice
description: You can learn common spells from a chosen school of magic. You can take this feat multiple times (once for each school of magic) but the training slot cost increases by 3 each time.

name: Fast Learner
description: Whenever you learn a new spell, you can attempt a {{skills.sorcery}} check to reduce the training slot cost by 1. The difficulty of the check is 12 plus the spell's level.

name: Sixth Sense
description: When sneaking, you have advantage on {{skills.perception}} checks to see if you have been detected.

name: Deep Repose
description: When you take the {{actions.rest}} action twice in the same turn, gain 3 willpower instead of 2.

name: Mana Regeneration
description: When you begin a combat turn with no willpower, gain 1 willpower.

name: Steady Hands
description: You can expend 1 willpower to gain advantage on a concentration saving throw (except those triggered by {{damage.lightning}} damage).

name: War Mage
description: You can cast offensive spells with a range of touch as an opportunity attack.

name: Multitasker
description: You can cast evocation spells while concentrating on another spell.

name: March
description: When you cast a spell, gain 6 feet of movement speed.

name: Arcane Adept
description: You can learn common spells from a chosen school of magic. You can take this feat multiple times (once for each school of magic) but the training slot cost increases by 3 each time.

name: Savant
description: Your HP is reduced by half, but you gain twice as much willpower from character level.

name: Well Rounded
description: Your instinct and charisma modifier scores are added together when calculating willpower.

name: Impetuous
description: Your willpower is increased by 4.

name: War Criminal Mage
description: You can now learn forbidden spells.

name: Rock Steady
description: You always have advantage on concentration saving throws.

name: Overclocked
description: You can concentrate on two spells at once.

name: Shock and Awe
description: The first spell you cast each battle costs half as much willpower.

name: Erudite
description: Ingratiated with collegiate fellows, academic spells cost 1 less training slot.

name: Silent Spell
description: Spells you cast are totally quiet to others.

name: Barrage
description: Whenever you cast two or more spells in one turn, gain 1 willpower.

name: Occultist
description: You can learn esoteric spells from any school(except Shamanism).

name: First Strike
description: As long as you're not surprised, you can attempt a DT 20 {{skills.initiative}} check to cast a spell before initiative is rolled.

name: Master of Ceremonies
description: Ceremonies cost half as much willpower to cast.

name: Primal Hunter
description: Your prey has disadvantage on saving throws against your Shamanic spells.

name: Mana Synthesis
description: When your begin a combat turn with less than 2 willpower, gain up to 2 willpower.

name: Arcane Master
description: Increase your maximum willpower by one for every esoteric or forbidden spell you've learned.

name: Paradigm Shift
description: Make a list of any 12 spells you do not know, then learn one at random (via rolling a d12). You do not need to meet any of the ordinary training requirements for the spell.

name: Mana Dynamo
description: When you begin a combat turn with less than 3 willpower, gain up to 3 willpower.

name: Heartbeat of Mana
description: The willpower cost of all spells is reduced by 1.

name: Boxer
description: You can add your {{skills.martial_arts}} proficiency to your damage when making unarmed attacks.

name: Tank
description: Your max hp is increased by your {{skills.defense}} proficiency bonus.

name: Fencer
description: You can use {{attr.DEX}} as the damage attribute for weapons with the {{weapon_keywords.nimble}} property.

name: Parkour
description: Gain a 1d4 bonus to {{skills.mobility}} checks when climbing.

name: Charger
description: You can use your {{attr.SPD}} modifier (instead of {{attr.STR}}) on {{skills.martial_arts}} checks with weapons that deal {{damage.piercing}} damage, as long as you moved that turn.

name: Leapfrog
description: When you jump, you can jump 1 foot higher and six feet farther.

name: Fast Walker
description: When you take the move action, you can move six feet farther.

name: Pensive
description: +1 to saving throws, but -1 to skill checks. +2 {{skills.defense}}

name: Sensitive
description: +1 to skill checks, but -1 to saving throws. +2 {{skills.perception}}

name: Jolly
description: Gain +1 on all skill checks as long as your willpower is full.

name: Billy Goat
description: You gain a 1d4 bonus when making {{skills.mobility}} saving throws.

name: Deep Breath
description: You can hold your breath twice as long as normal.

name: Pratfaller
description: Fall damage is reduced by 2d6.

name: Double Dodger
description: You can take the {{actions.dodge}} action twice in the same turn to gain twice as .

name: Freestyler
description: Swim speed is increased by 6 feet per turn.

name: Restless
description: Whenever you take the {{actions.move}} action, you can make {{skills.martial_arts}} checks using your speed modifier (instead of strength or dexterity) until the start of your next turn.

name: Triage
description: When you take the help action, allies heal twice as much hp.

name: Charlatan
description: You can use {{attr.CHA}} as a base attribute for {{skills.sorcery}} checks.

name: Loremaster
description: You can make recognition rolls using the {{skills.folklore}} skill, instead of {{skills.survival}}.

name: Hot Tempered
description: When you take 5 or more damage in a single blow, gain 1 willpower, as long as you're not wearing heavy armor (i.e. chainmail or plate).

name: Momentum
description: Gain 12 feet of movement speed every time you kill an opponent.

name: Friend in Need
description: You can take the "move" and "help" actions in two actions (instead of three).

name: Lancer
description: You have advantage when making mounted attacks with a polearm.

name: Spellsword
description: When you make a weapon attack on an enemy, it has disadvantage on spell saving throws against your spells until the start of its next turn. When you make a spell attack on an enemy, you have advantage on weapon attacks against it until the start of your next turn.

name: Bookworm
description: You can make recognition rolls using the {{skills.literacy}} skill, instead of {{skills.survival}}

name: Dungeoneer
description: Gain a 1d4 bonus to {{skills.perception}} when exploring dungeons, and to {{skills.legerdemain}} when disarming traps.

name: Prankster
description: You have advantage on rolls to convince your marks that your shenanigans (pickpocketing, lockpicking, deceptions, etc) are harmless pranks.

name: Exceptional
description: Gain +1 willpower whenever you deal a critical hit.

name: Guardian
description: When you take the block action, allies adjacent to you also benefit from the increased BC.

name: That Dog
description: Whenever you take damage that would knock you unconscious, you can expend willpower to remain   conscious (at 1 hp). The willpower required is equal to the excess damage.

name: Bonebreaker
description: Damage from critical hits with {{damage.bludgeoning}} weapons is tripled, instead of doubled.

name: Keshik
description: You no longer have disadvantage on ranged attacks from horseback.

name: Marathon
description: Jogging costs only one action.

name: Surge
description: You can expend 3 willpower to gain an action, once per turn.

name: Medic
description: Whenever you take a breather, you can attempt a {{skills.medicine}} check to heal a party member to full health. The difficulty of the check is equal to their missing health.

name: Stoic
description: Whenever you take a breather, regain all your willpower.

name: Party Animal
description: Whenever you take a breather, you and everyone in your party regains an additional 1d4 willpower.

name: Skull-Crusher
description: When making a heavy attack, the damage dice are added together instead of taking the maximum value.

name: Rage Reflexes
description: When you take 8 or more damage in a single blow, gain 1 willpower.

name: Onslaught
description: When you make a weapon attack, the penalty to your DC is reduced by 1.

name: Adrenaline Rush
description: Gain +1 temporary willpower at the start of battle.

name: Wall Jump
description: When you take the jump action next to a wall, your jump distance is doubled.

name: Walking Mountain
description: Your armor BC is added to your maximum willpower.

name: Double Dog
description: The willpower required to stay conscious (via the {{feats.that_dog}} feat) is reduced by one half (but cannot be reduced below 1).

name: Disengaged
description: Enemies have disadvantage on opportunity attacks against you.

name: Surge 2
description: The willpower cost of the "Surge" ability is reduced to 2.

name: Titan
description: Gain +1 willpower when an attack is blocked by your armor.

name: Fleetfooted
description: Your first move action each turn no longer costs an action.

name: Doggone
description: The willpower required to stay conscious (via the {{feats.that_dog}} feat) is reduced by one third instead of one half (but cannot be reduced below 1).

name: Surge 3
description: The willpower cost of the "Surge" ability is reduced to 1.

name: Shield Bash
description: You can make a bludgeoning attack when carrying a {{weapons.buckler}} or {{weapons.shield}} in your offhand.

name: Parry
description: You may attempt to parry melee attacks using a reaction. When parrying, your BC is increased by the parry stat of the weapon.

name: Dodge Roll
description: When you take the dodge action, you gain 6 feet of movement. You cannot dodge roll while wearing heavy armor.

name: Heavy Attack
description: When making a two-handed weapon attack, you can expend 1 willpower to make it a heavy attack. Roll the damage dice twice and take the higher result.

name: Tactical Shove
description: As an action, you can shove an opponent. Roll for {{skills.martial_arts}} while your opponent makes a {{skills.defense}} saving throw. If your attack rolls exceeds your opponent's defense roll, they are pushed 6 feet backwards and fall {{status.prone}}.

name: Dual Wielder
description: When you make a melee weapon attack while dual wielding, you can make a secondary attack with your offhand weapon . The second attack does not benefit from any attribute modifier but is otherwise an ordinary weapon attack.

name: Stop, Drop, and Roll
description: You can expend 2 actions to extinguish all accumulated {{status.burning}}.

name: Vertical Escape
description: You may use the {{weapons.grappling_hook}} to make a hasty escape as a combat action. If surroundings are appropriate, you can attempt a difficulty 12 {{skills.mobility}} check to throw the hook up to 30 feet vertically. If it latches, you can use an action to climb 10 feet up the rope, away from enemy melee attacks.

name: Polearm Charge
description: Whenever you {{actions.jog}} while carrying a polearm weapon, you can make a weapon attack without using an action. You can use your {{attr.SPD}} instead of {{attr.STR}} modifier for this attack.

name: Cleaving Strike
description: When making a melee attack with a heavy weapon that deals {{damage.slashing}} damage (but not a polearm), you can expend 2 willpower to strike an additional foe if more than one foe is in range.

name: Mordhau Strike
description: You can use certain swords with the {{weapon_keywords.mordhau}} property to deal {{damage.bludgeoning}} damage. The damage dice is changed accordingly.

name: Flailing Strike
description: Attacks you make with a flail ignore extra BC provided by shields.

name: Riposte
description: You may expend 2 willpower to follow up a successful parry with a counterattack.

name: Estoc Strike
description: Your attacks with the Estoc ignore half of your opponent's BC if they are wearing chain mail.

name: Feint Attack
description: You can feign an attack against a target to lower its DC. To do so, make an ordinary {{skills.martial_arts}} attack roll while your opponent makes a {{skills.martial_arts}} saving throw. If your roll is higher than theirs, their DC is lowered by 1d8 until the start of their next turn.

name: Haft Strike
description: When you make a melee attack with a polearm, you can expend 1 willpower to follow it up with a haft strike. The haft strike deals a flat 1d4 {{damage.bludgeoning}} damage and does not benefit from any attribute modifier or the extended reach of the polearm.

name: Shield Charge
description: When you take the jog action while carrying a shield, you can make a 1d4 plus your speed modifier in {{damage.bludgeoning}} damage to an enemy. Dealing damage to any enemy in this way consumes your remaining movement points.

name: Come Hither
description: Using an action, the player may throw the grappling hook at a target within 20 feet. Upon a successful {{skills.accuracy}} check against the target’s {{keywords.mit}}, the target is pulled up to 15 feet towards the player.

name: Disarming Strike
description: You can make a special attack with the {{weapons.hook_sword}} to disarm your opponent. To do so, make an ordinary {{skills.martial_arts}} attack roll while your opponent makes a {{skills.martial_arts}} saving throw. If your roll is higher than theirs, their weapon is wrenched from their grasp and tossed 1d20 feet away.

name: Balestra
description: You can expend 2 willpower to leap towards an enemy and make a weapon attack as a single action. You can move away from this enemy (this turn) without provoking an opportunity attack.

name: Evasion
description: You can {{actions.move}} and {{actions.dodge}} as a combined single action.

name: Blunt Cleave
description: You can use the cleaving strike maneuver with weapons that deal {{damage.bludgeoning}} damage.

name: Backflip
description: A tactical backflip allows you to create space between you and your opponents while looking incredibly badass. When you get hit, you can backflip as a reaction, reducing damage by 1d6 and moving up to 6 feet away (without provoking opportunity attacks). You cannot backflip while wearing heavy armor.

name: Unstoppable
description: When performing a shield charge, you can expend one willpower after hitting an enemy to continue the charge and damage an additional enemies. The willpower cost increases by 1 for each additional enemy that you hit.

name: Link Strike
description: When dual wielding hook swords, you can make a special attack that has increased damage and reach. Damage is increased to 2d6, and reach is increased to 6 feet.

name: Steel Avalanche
description: You can expend 2 willpower to increase the damage of a two-handed melee weapon attack by your armor BC.

name: Steel Dervish
description: You can expend 2 willpower to increase the damage of a {{weapon_keywords.nimble}} weapon by your DC, but your DC becomes zero until the start of your next turn.

name: Steel Lightning
description: You can expend 2 willpower to increase the damage of a {{damage.piercing}} weapon attack by 1 for every 6 feet you've moved that turn. If used as the first action of your turn, you can use your movement distance from the previous turn.

name: Bloodthirsty
description: When you get a kill during a rage, your rage level increases by 1.

name: Perseverance
description: Your rage sustains you in your darkest hour. Once per turn, when you take damage while below half hp, your rage level increases by 1.

name: Anger Management
description: The cost to rage is decreased from 3 to 2.

name: Thunderin' Tarnation
description: Magic is stupid, but you can make it go away by yelling at it. Enemies which fail their saving throw against your roar may not cast spells on their next turn, and lose concentration on any spells they have already cast.

name: Sword of Truth
description: Gain advantage on {{skills.persuasion}} checks whenever you brandish your weapon.

name: Shield of Faith
description: Your shield's BC is added when making saving throws against spells, as long as you are blocking.

name: Armor of God
description: Add half your armor BC when making saving throws against spells.

name: Immortal
description: The penalty to maximum DC when wearing heavy armor is reduced by 2.

name: Praetorian
description: You can use the "Riposte" skill for only one willpower.

name: Samurai
description: You no longer have disadvantage to {{skills.mobility}} checks while wearing armor.

name: Templar
description: Ignore disadvantage on stealth checks while wearing full plate.

name: Recidivism
description: You have advantage on skill checks for actions that are against the law.

name: Crazy Eights
description: Whenever you roll an 8 on a d20, something unexpected happens. It is what it is.

name: Mastermind
description: You have advantage on {{skills.persuasion}} rolls to convince unscrupulous folk to carry out your plans, and can always find specialists of the appropriate skill for the job.

name: Lucky Sevens
description: When you roll a seven on a d20, it counts as a natural 20.

name: Desperado
description: You have advantage on skill checks and saving throws whenever an ally is downed or unconscious.

name: Hold the Line
description: Whenever you succeed a spell saving throw, adjacent allies succeed too.

name: Teamwork
description: When you make a heavy attack while adjacent to an ally, you can expend 2 willpower to add your {{attr.CHA}} modifier to the damage.
